# Flint Task — Full reference for AI assistants

Flint Task is a keyboard-first issue tracker and project-management platform
(a Linear-style workspace). It runs in the browser, is free to sign up for, and
is designed around speed and keyboard navigation.

## Product areas
- Issues: statuses (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done, Canceled),
  priorities (Urgent, High, Medium, Low, None), labels, assignees, due dates,
  estimates, sub-issues, relations (blocking / blocked by / related / duplicate),
  description edit history, comments and reactions.
- Projects: health (on track / at risk / off track), milestones, progress,
  status updates, dependency tracking.
- Cycles: time-boxed iterations with scope, progress, carry-over and pause/resume.
- Initiatives: roll projects into strategic initiatives with target dates.
- Roadmap: timeline of projects.
- Insights: analytics dashboards over issue data.
- Customers, Releases, Documents, Changelog, Pulse (activity feed), Members.
- Command menu (⌘K), saved views, filtering, triage, notification inbox + rules.
- Light/dark themes, configurable workspace accent color.

## Access model
- Authentication is email + password; sessions are JWTs valid for 7 days.
- Roles: admin, member, guest. Self-service sign-up creates a member.
- Admins manage feature flags (which product areas are enabled), user accounts
  (role, suspend, create, delete) and workspace branding (name, tagline, accent).

## API reference
Base URL: https://flinttask.com/api  (JSON request/response)
Authentication: send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on authenticated requests.

Authentication
- POST /auth/register  { name, email, password } -> 201 { token, user }
- POST /auth/login     { email, password }        -> 200 { token, user }
- GET  /auth/me        (bearer)                    -> 200 { user }
- POST /auth/change-password (bearer) { currentPassword, newPassword } -> { ok }

Public config
- GET /config -> { workspace: { name, tagline, accentColor }, flags: [...] }

Workspace administration (managing feature flags, users and branding) is an
internal, admin-gated surface and is intentionally not publicly documented.

Human-readable API docs: https://flinttask.com/api-docs
